li.text: As an alternative to a direct mouse click, the status of the checkboxes can also be changed using the space bar for the currently selected list item.

li.text: The check status can also be set by moving the mouse cursor vertically downwards right of the checkboxes (above the text) while holding down the left mouse button - moving it upwards removes the check status.

text.style: font-family:Verdana; font-size:10pt; font-weight:normal; font-style:normal; text-decoration:none; text-transform:none; vertical-align:baseline; color:#000000; background-color:transparent; letter-spacing:normal; letter-scaling:100%;

li.text: Double-clicking in any line behind the text or in the right quarter of the list negates the current status of all items.

para.text: This approach is impractical for large lists that cannot be displayed completely in the filter window. In this case, masks for automatically check list elements can be defined in a separate context menu window (accessible via right-click).

para.text: If a subset of checkboxes is checked, the display can be grouped by double-clicking in the first panel of the status bar; this means that all checked items are displayed at the top of the list. Double-clicking again removes the grouping; after automatic marking through the context menu window, grouping is done automatically.
